response.content:

It's also wonderful that you're taking the time to blend your foundation and fix your eyeliner carefully. Attention to detail can make a big difference in how polished and put-together you feel. Plus, it's great that you're taking care of your skin and eyes, which are essential parts of your overall appearance.
